idea-plugin.name: EmmyLua Enhanced
idea-plugin.description:
Lua support for Unreal Engine (UnLua) projects, based on EmmyLua.

  • Language support powered by the official EmmyLua language server (emmylua_ls, via LSP4IJ): go to definition, completion, find usages, rename, diagnostics, formatting, semantic highlighting.
  • UE / UnLua: picks up UnLua IntelliSense or UELink-generated declarations automatically.
  • Debugging: attach to a local process (Windows), attach to an Android device without changing the package, and an MCP server so AI agents can debug Lua.

基于 EmmyLua 的 Lua 插件，面向 UE（UnLua）项目：

  • 语言支持基于 EmmyLua 官方语言服务器 emmylua_ls（经 LSP4IJ）：跳转、补全、查找引用、重命名、诊断、格式化、语义高亮
  • UE / UnLua：自动加入 UnLua IntelliSense 或 UELink 后台生成的声明
  • Lua 调试：附加本机进程（Windows）、Android 真机附加（包体零改动）、给 AI Agent 用的 MCP 调试工具
idea-plugin.change-notes: 每个版本的更新内容见 GitHub Releases。
